name: Emie Shimada
source:
A student at Santo Astronautic High School and one of Rei’s closest friends. Emie lives by impulse, if there’s danger ahead, she’ll be the first to leap into it without hesitation. Her fiery temper burns just as brightly as her wit, making her a whirlwind of sharp words and bold actions.

At first glance, she might seem reckless, but her instincts hide a cleverness that often uncovers solutions no one else can see. That mix of passion and insight makes her unpredictable, frustrating at times, yet impossible to ignore.
